toegepas.voor: kos, klere, musiek, diens en besoek
toegepas.na: kos, klere, musiek, dienste en besoeke
toegepas.rede_vinder: The singular 'diens en besoek' reads stiff in a list of things you see at a festival; the plural countable nouns read naturally.
toegepas.fout: The singular 'diens en besoek' in a list of things seen at a festival reads stiff and suggests one particular service and visit.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The plural 'dienste en besoeke' is what a fluent writer would put in this list, and it says the same thing.

toegepas.na: Die Islamitiese kalender volg die maan
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die Islamitiese kalender' is the established Afrikaans name; the hyphenated compound reads like a translation.
toegepas.fout: 'Moslem-kalender' is a loose compound where Afrikaans has an established name.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die Islamitiese kalender' is the standard name, the meaning is unchanged, and the protected 'Moslems' stays everywhere it appears with no forbidden form added.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Soet kos' is vague and wooden; 'soet geregte' says the same thing more naturally.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Soet kos' is plain and natural for Grade 5, while 'geregte' means prepared dishes and narrows the sweets and biscuits that families share.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Daar' repeats 'na die tempel toe' in the same sentence and adds nothing.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Om daar te aanbid' is ordinary natural Afrikaans, so dropping 'daar' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Gedurende' is the natural preposition for a period of time like a month of fasting.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'In Ramadan' is correct, natural Afrikaans for a month (as in 'in Desember'), and the change would reword a glossary definition for no real gain.

na_skrywer.voor: met opset nie te eet nie
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Met opset' carries a sense of deliberate wrongdoing in Afrikaans; 'doelbewus' is neutral and clearer for a definition.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Met opset' can carry a sense of deliberate wrongdoing, which sits awkwardly in a neutral definition of a religious practice.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The point is fair, but it rewords a glossary definition beyond spelling or grammar, so the writer must decide.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Die maand waarin Moslems van dagbreek tot sononder vas.
vlae.rede: Read on its own the glossary entry says all Muslims fast, while the study text says 'Die meeste volwasse Moslems' and exempts young children, sick people and travellers; the qualifier is a content decision, so it is flagged rather than changed.

laat_vaar_vorige.na: en daardie maand word Ramadan genoem
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'daardie maand is Ramadan' is wooden; naming the month reads more naturally.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'daardie maand is Ramadan' is plain and correct; 'word Ramadan genoem' is only a different way of saying it.
